title: Ruby and Luna | Read Along | Luna Story Time
description:
A starry egg arrives at Ruby’s door, and Ruby and her dragon friends protect it until Luna hatches. Together they discover that a dark dragon can shine brightly.

Book Three of Ruby and the Dragon Bonds. Written with love by Luna, Sunny, and Mommy.

Listen and follow the highlighted words through this illustrated read-along, with a gentle original score.

Read the illustrated book: https://kolatts.github.io/luna-story-time/reader.html?book=ruby-and-luna
